scale.pred_err: mean squared distance between the predicted and the actual next vestibular token; 0 = exact, persist_err = the score of predicting no change
scale.improvement_over_persistence: 1 - pred_err / persist_err: 0 = no better than 'nothing changes', 1 = exact, negative = worse
scale.head_tilt_deg: angle of the head from its lying-still-on-the-back orientation, by gravity: 0 = that orientation, 90 = a quarter turn, 180 = upside down
scale.trunk_roll_deg: how far the trunk has rolled from lying on its back, either way: 0 = on the back, 90 = on a side, 180 = face down
scale.trunk_pitch_deg: 0 = trunk horizontal, 90 = head straight up, -90 = head straight down
scale.per_body: the same three per body; trunk_roll_deg there is signed (+ and - are the two sides) and is the direction average over the window
scale.support_trunk: share of outside support carried by the trunk (0-1)
scale.limit_load: share of motor-driven joints within 2.0 degrees of a limit (0-1)
scale.clipped_share: share of real raw values the input bound changed (0 = none). The bound is 4 in each field's own unit: 4 g for the head accelerometer, 4 body weights for support_total, and 4 times the measured 99th percentile for the gyro, neck speeds and the two efforts
scale.lesson_share: the vestibular term's share of the next-moment lesson over the window, at its declared weight (0 = none of the lesson, 1 = all of it; an equal share among five graded senses is 0.2)
scale.input_clipped_share: share of the encoder's centred and scaled inputs that the bound of 4 running spreads changed (0 = none)
scale.input_spread_min: the smallest running spread of any field, in that field's unit, beside the floor it never falls below
scale.input_centre_filled_share: how much of the running mean's 2,000-moment horizon real frames have filled (0 = no real frame yet, 1 = full)
scale.liveness: per hidden layer of the encoder, the share of its units whose input rose above -3 on some moment of the window (0 = a dead layer, 1 = every unit took part)

controllability.gate_why: 32 of the last 32 orders agreed better with what the model expected from the order it sent than with what it would have expected from another body's order (a coin flip gives 16 of 32). The average advantage is 15.1 times its own measurement noise; the gate opens above 3 times and, once open, closes below 1 time. It is open.

scale.persistence_ema: mean squared change of the sense's token between moments; 0 = the token never changes
scale.weight_effective: 1 = as in the plain sum; 2 = the sense counts twice its raw error
scale.share_plain/share_normalized: of every 1.0 of the lesson, the part each sense carries, plain sum vs normalised
scale.ratio: 0 = predicted exactly, 1 = no better than 'nothing changes', above 1 = worse
scale.weight_cap: no sense weighs more than this; measured as the largest weight any sense needed in any 100-step window of H84 segments 30-31

scale.pred_err: mean squared distance between the predicted and the actual next vestibular token; 0 = exact, persist_err = the score of predicting no change
scale.improvement_over_persistence: 1 - pred_err / persist_err: 0 = no better than 'nothing changes', 1 = exact, negative = worse
scale.head_tilt_deg: angle of the head from its lying-still-on-the-back orientation, by gravity: 0 = that orientation, 90 = a quarter turn, 180 = upside down
scale.trunk_roll_deg: how far the trunk has rolled from lying on its back, either way: 0 = on the back, 90 = on a side, 180 = face down
scale.trunk_pitch_deg: 0 = trunk horizontal, 90 = head straight up, -90 = head straight down
scale.per_body: the same three per body; trunk_roll_deg there is signed (+ and - are the two sides) and is the direction average over the window
scale.support_trunk: share of outside support carried by the trunk (0-1)
scale.limit_load: share of motor-driven joints within 2.0 degrees of a limit (0-1)
scale.clipped_share: share of real raw values the input bound changed (0 = none). The bound is 4 in each field's own unit: 4 g for the head accelerometer, 4 body weights for support_total, and 4 times the measured 99th percentile for the gyro, neck speeds and the two efforts
scale.lesson_share: the vestibular term's share of the next-moment lesson over the window, at its declared weight (0 = none of the lesson, 1 = all of it; an equal share among five graded senses is 0.2)
scale.input_clipped_share: share of the encoder's centred and scaled inputs that the bound of 4 running spreads changed (0 = none)
scale.input_spread_min: the smallest running spread of any field, in that field's unit, beside the floor it never falls below
scale.input_centre_filled_share: how much of the running mean's 2,000-moment horizon real frames have filled (0 = no real frame yet, 1 = full)
scale.liveness: per hidden layer of the encoder, the share of its units whose input rose above -3 on some moment of the window (0 = a dead layer, 1 = every unit took part)

controllability.gate_why: 32 of the last 32 orders agreed better with what the model expected from the order it sent than with what it would have expected from another body's order (a coin flip gives 16 of 32). The average advantage is 14.5 times its own measurement noise; the gate opens above 3 times and, once open, closes below 1 time. It is open.

scale.persistence_ema: mean squared change of the sense's token between moments; 0 = the token never changes
scale.weight_effective: 1 = as in the plain sum; 2 = the sense counts twice its raw error
scale.share_plain/share_normalized: of every 1.0 of the lesson, the part each sense carries, plain sum vs normalised
scale.ratio: 0 = predicted exactly, 1 = no better than 'nothing changes', above 1 = worse
scale.weight_cap: no sense weighs more than this; measured as the largest weight any sense needed in any 100-step window of H84 segments 30-31

scale.pred_err: mean squared distance between the predicted and the actual next vestibular token; 0 = exact, persist_err = the score of predicting no change
scale.improvement_over_persistence: 1 - pred_err / persist_err: 0 = no better than 'nothing changes', 1 = exact, negative = worse
scale.head_tilt_deg: angle of the head from its lying-still-on-the-back orientation, by gravity: 0 = that orientation, 90 = a quarter turn, 180 = upside down
scale.trunk_roll_deg: how far the trunk has rolled from lying on its back, either way: 0 = on the back, 90 = on a side, 180 = face down
scale.trunk_pitch_deg: 0 = trunk horizontal, 90 = head straight up, -90 = head straight down
scale.per_body: the same three per body; trunk_roll_deg there is signed (+ and - are the two sides) and is the direction average over the window
scale.support_trunk: share of outside support carried by the trunk (0-1)
scale.limit_load: share of motor-driven joints within 2.0 degrees of a limit (0-1)
scale.clipped_share: share of real raw values the input bound changed (0 = none). The bound is 4 in each field's own unit: 4 g for the head accelerometer, 4 body weights for support_total, and 4 times the measured 99th percentile for the gyro, neck speeds and the two efforts
scale.lesson_share: the vestibular term's share of the next-moment lesson over the window, at its declared weight (0 = none of the lesson, 1 = all of it; an equal share among five graded senses is 0.2)
scale.input_clipped_share: share of the encoder's centred and scaled inputs that the bound of 4 running spreads changed (0 = none)
scale.input_spread_min: the smallest running spread of any field, in that field's unit, beside the floor it never falls below
scale.input_centre_filled_share: how much of the running mean's 2,000-moment horizon real frames have filled (0 = no real frame yet, 1 = full)
scale.liveness: per hidden layer of the encoder, the share of its units whose input rose above -3 on some moment of the window (0 = a dead layer, 1 = every unit took part)

controllability.gate_why: 32 of the last 32 orders agreed better with what the model expected from the order it sent than with what it would have expected from another body's order (a coin flip gives 16 of 32). The average advantage is 20.5 times its own measurement noise; the gate opens above 3 times and, once open, closes below 1 time. It is open.

scale.persistence_ema: mean squared change of the sense's token between moments; 0 = the token never changes
scale.weight_effective: 1 = as in the plain sum; 2 = the sense counts twice its raw error
scale.share_plain/share_normalized: of every 1.0 of the lesson, the part each sense carries, plain sum vs normalised
scale.ratio: 0 = predicted exactly, 1 = no better than 'nothing changes', above 1 = worse
scale.weight_cap: no sense weighs more than this; measured as the largest weight any sense needed in any 100-step window of H84 segments 30-31

scale.pred_err: mean squared distance between the predicted and the actual next vestibular token; 0 = exact, persist_err = the score of predicting no change
scale.improvement_over_persistence: 1 - pred_err / persist_err: 0 = no better than 'nothing changes', 1 = exact, negative = worse
scale.head_tilt_deg: angle of the head from its lying-still-on-the-back orientation, by gravity: 0 = that orientation, 90 = a quarter turn, 180 = upside down
scale.trunk_roll_deg: how far the trunk has rolled from lying on its back, either way: 0 = on the back, 90 = on a side, 180 = face down
scale.trunk_pitch_deg: 0 = trunk horizontal, 90 = head straight up, -90 = head straight down
scale.per_body: the same three per body; trunk_roll_deg there is signed (+ and - are the two sides) and is the direction average over the window
scale.support_trunk: share of outside support carried by the trunk (0-1)
scale.limit_load: share of motor-driven joints within 2.0 degrees of a limit (0-1)
scale.clipped_share: share of real raw values the input bound changed (0 = none). The bound is 4 in each field's own unit: 4 g for the head accelerometer, 4 body weights for support_total, and 4 times the measured 99th percentile for the gyro, neck speeds and the two efforts
scale.lesson_share: the vestibular term's share of the next-moment lesson over the window, at its declared weight (0 = none of the lesson, 1 = all of it; an equal share among five graded senses is 0.2)
scale.input_clipped_share: share of the encoder's centred and scaled inputs that the bound of 4 running spreads changed (0 = none)
scale.input_spread_min: the smallest running spread of any field, in that field's unit, beside the floor it never falls below
scale.input_centre_filled_share: how much of the running mean's 2,000-moment horizon real frames have filled (0 = no real frame yet, 1 = full)
scale.liveness: per hidden layer of the encoder, the share of its units whose input rose above -3 on some moment of the window (0 = a dead layer, 1 = every unit took part)

controllability.gate_why: 32 of the last 32 orders agreed better with what the model expected from the order it sent than with what it would have expected from another body's order (a coin flip gives 16 of 32). The average advantage is 18.1 times its own measurement noise; the gate opens above 3 times and, once open, closes below 1 time. It is open.

scale.persistence_ema: mean squared change of the sense's token between moments; 0 = the token never changes
scale.weight_effective: 1 = as in the plain sum; 2 = the sense counts twice its raw error
scale.share_plain/share_normalized: of every 1.0 of the lesson, the part each sense carries, plain sum vs normalised
scale.ratio: 0 = predicted exactly, 1 = no better than 'nothing changes', above 1 = worse
scale.weight_cap: no sense weighs more than this; measured as the largest weight any sense needed in any 100-step window of H84 segments 30-31

scale.input_centre_filled_share: how much of the running mean's 2,000-moment horizon real frames have filled (0 = no real frame yet, 1 = full)
scale.liveness: per hidden layer of the encoder, the share of its units whose input rose above -3 on some moment of the window (0 = a dead layer, 1 = every unit took part)

controllability.gate_why: 32 of the last 32 orders agreed better with what the model expected from the order it sent than with what it would have expected from another body's order (a coin flip gives 16 of 32). The average advantage is 16.0 times its own measurement noise; the gate opens above 3 times and, once open, closes below 1 time. It is open.

scale.persistence_ema: mean squared change of the sense's token between moments; 0 = the token never changes
scale.weight_effective: 1 = as in the plain sum; 2 = the sense counts twice its raw error
scale.share_plain/share_normalized: of every 1.0 of the lesson, the part each sense carries, plain sum vs normalised
scale.ratio: 0 = predicted exactly, 1 = no better than 'nothing changes', above 1 = worse
scale.weight_cap: no sense weighs more than this; measured as the largest weight any sense needed in any 100-step window of H84 segments 30-31

scale.per_body: the same three per body; trunk_roll_deg there is signed (+ and - are the two sides) and is the direction average over the window
scale.support_trunk: share of outside support carried by the trunk (0-1)
scale.limit_load: share of motor-driven joints within 2.0 degrees of a limit (0-1)
scale.clipped_share: share of real raw values the input bound changed (0 = none). The bound is 4 in each field's own unit: 4 g for the head accelerometer, 4 body weights for support_total, and 4 times the measured 99th percentile for the gyro, neck speeds and the two efforts
scale.lesson_share: the vestibular term's share of the next-moment lesson over the window, at its declared weight (0 = none of the lesson, 1 = all of it; an equal share among five graded senses is 0.2)
scale.input_clipped_share: share of the encoder's centred and scaled inputs that the bound of 4 running spreads changed (0 = none)
scale.input_spread_min: the smallest running spread of any field, in that field's unit, beside the floor it never falls below
scale.input_centre_filled_share: how much of the running mean's 2,000-moment horizon real frames have filled (0 = no real frame yet, 1 = full)
scale.liveness: per hidden layer of the encoder, the share of its units whose input rose above -3 on some moment of the window (0 = a dead layer, 1 = every unit took part)

controllability.gate_why: 32 of the last 32 orders agreed better with what the model expected from the order it sent than with what it would have expected from another body's order (a coin flip gives 16 of 32). The average advantage is 16.1 times its own measurement noise; the gate opens above 3 times and, once open, closes below 1 time. It is open.

scale.weight_effective: 1 = as in the plain sum; 2 = the sense counts twice its raw error
scale.share_plain/share_normalized: of every 1.0 of the lesson, the part each sense carries, plain sum vs normalised
scale.ratio: 0 = predicted exactly, 1 = no better than 'nothing changes', above 1 = worse
scale.weight_cap: no sense weighs more than this; measured as the largest weight any sense needed in any 100-step window of H84 segments 30-31

scale.limit_load: share of motor-driven joints within 2.0 degrees of a limit (0-1)
scale.clipped_share: share of real raw values the input bound changed (0 = none). The bound is 4 in each field's own unit: 4 g for the head accelerometer, 4 body weights for support_total, and 4 times the measured 99th percentile for the gyro, neck speeds and the two efforts
scale.lesson_share: the vestibular term's share of the next-moment lesson over the window, at its declared weight (0 = none of the lesson, 1 = all of it; an equal share among five graded senses is 0.2)
scale.input_clipped_share: share of the encoder's centred and scaled inputs that the bound of 4 running spreads changed (0 = none)
scale.input_spread_min: the smallest running spread of any field, in that field's unit, beside the floor it never falls below
scale.input_centre_filled_share: how much of the running mean's 2,000-moment horizon real frames have filled (0 = no real frame yet, 1 = full)
scale.liveness: per hidden layer of the encoder, the share of its units whose input rose above -3 on some moment of the window (0 = a dead layer, 1 = every unit took part)

controllability.gate_why: 32 of the last 32 orders agreed better with what the model expected from the order it sent than with what it would have expected from another body's order (a coin flip gives 16 of 32). The average advantage is 17.3 times its own measurement noise; the gate opens above 3 times and, once open, closes below 1 time. It is open.

scale.persistence_ema: mean squared change of the sense's token between moments; 0 = the token never changes
scale.weight_effective: 1 = as in the plain sum; 2 = the sense counts twice its raw error
scale.share_plain/share_normalized: of every 1.0 of the lesson, the part each sense carries, plain sum vs normalised
scale.ratio: 0 = predicted exactly, 1 = no better than 'nothing changes', above 1 = worse
scale.weight_cap: no sense weighs more than this; measured as the largest weight any sense needed in any 100-step window of H84 segments 30-31

scale.pred_err: mean squared distance between the predicted and the actual next vestibular token; 0 = exact, persist_err = the score of predicting no change
scale.improvement_over_persistence: 1 - pred_err / persist_err: 0 = no better than 'nothing changes', 1 = exact, negative = worse
scale.head_tilt_deg: angle of the head from its lying-still-on-the-back orientation, by gravity: 0 = that orientation, 90 = a quarter turn, 180 = upside down
scale.trunk_roll_deg: how far the trunk has rolled from lying on its back, either way: 0 = on the back, 90 = on a side, 180 = face down
scale.trunk_pitch_deg: 0 = trunk horizontal, 90 = head straight up, -90 = head straight down
scale.per_body: the same three per body; trunk_roll_deg there is signed (+ and - are the two sides) and is the direction average over the window
scale.support_trunk: share of outside support carried by the trunk (0-1)
scale.limit_load: share of motor-driven joints within 2.0 degrees of a limit (0-1)
scale.clipped_share: share of real raw values the input bound changed (0 = none). The bound is 4 in each field's own unit: 4 g for the head accelerometer, 4 body weights for support_total, and 4 times the measured 99th percentile for the gyro, neck speeds and the two efforts
scale.lesson_share: the vestibular term's share of the next-moment lesson over the window, at its declared weight (0 = none of the lesson, 1 = all of it; an equal share among five graded senses is 0.2)
scale.input_clipped_share: share of the encoder's centred and scaled inputs that the bound of 4 running spreads changed (0 = none)
scale.input_spread_min: the smallest running spread of any field, in that field's unit, beside the floor it never falls below
scale.input_centre_filled_share: how much of the running mean's 2,000-moment horizon real frames have filled (0 = no real frame yet, 1 = full)
scale.liveness: per hidden layer of the encoder, the share of its units whose input rose above -3 on some moment of the window (0 = a dead layer, 1 = every unit took part)

controllability.gate_why: 32 of the last 32 orders agreed better with what the model expected from the order it sent than with what it would have expected from another body's order (a coin flip gives 16 of 32). The average advantage is 19.4 times its own measurement noise; the gate opens above 3 times and, once open, closes below 1 time. It is open.

scale.persistence_ema: mean squared change of the sense's token between moments; 0 = the token never changes
scale.weight_effective: 1 = as in the plain sum; 2 = the sense counts twice its raw error
scale.share_plain/share_normalized: of every 1.0 of the lesson, the part each sense carries, plain sum vs normalised
scale.ratio: 0 = predicted exactly, 1 = no better than 'nothing changes', above 1 = worse
scale.weight_cap: no sense weighs more than this; measured as the largest weight any sense needed in any 100-step window of H84 segments 30-31

scale.support_trunk: share of outside support carried by the trunk (0-1)
scale.limit_load: share of motor-driven joints within 2.0 degrees of a limit (0-1)

scale.pred_err: mean squared distance between the predicted and the actual next vestibular token; 0 = exact, persist_err = the score of predicting no change
scale.improvement_over_persistence: 1 - pred_err / persist_err: 0 = no better than 'nothing changes', 1 = exact, negative = worse
scale.head_tilt_deg: angle of the head from its lying-still-on-the-back orientation, by gravity: 0 = that orientation, 90 = a quarter turn, 180 = upside down
scale.trunk_roll_deg: how far the trunk has rolled from lying on its back, either way: 0 = on the back, 90 = on a side, 180 = face down
scale.trunk_pitch_deg: 0 = trunk horizontal, 90 = head straight up, -90 = head straight down
scale.per_body: the same three per body; trunk_roll_deg there is signed (+ and - are the two sides) and is the direction average over the window
scale.support_trunk: share of outside support carried by the trunk (0-1)
scale.limit_load: share of motor-driven joints within 2.0 degrees of a limit (0-1)
scale.clipped_share: share of real raw values the input bound changed (0 = none). The bound is 4 in each field's own unit: 4 g for the head accelerometer, 4 body weights for support_total, and 4 times the measured 99th percentile for the gyro, neck speeds and the two efforts
scale.lesson_share: the vestibular term's share of the next-moment lesson over the window, at its declared weight (0 = none of the lesson, 1 = all of it; an equal share among five graded senses is 0.2)
scale.input_clipped_share: share of the encoder's centred and scaled inputs that the bound of 4 running spreads changed (0 = none)
scale.input_spread_min: the smallest running spread of any field, in that field's unit, beside the floor it never falls below
scale.input_centre_filled_share: how much of the running mean's 2,000-moment horizon real frames have filled (0 = no real frame yet, 1 = full)
scale.liveness: per hidden layer of the encoder, the share of its units whose input rose above -3 on some moment of the window (0 = a dead layer, 1 = every unit took part)

controllability.gate_why: 32 of the last 32 orders agreed better with what the model expected from the order it sent than with what it would have expected from another body's order (a coin flip gives 16 of 32). The average advantage is 18.1 times its own measurement noise; the gate opens above 3 times and, once open, closes below 1 time. It is open.

scale.persistence_ema: mean squared change of the sense's token between moments; 0 = the token never changes
scale.weight_effective: 1 = as in the plain sum; 2 = the sense counts twice its raw error
scale.share_plain/share_normalized: of every 1.0 of the lesson, the part each sense carries, plain sum vs normalised
scale.ratio: 0 = predicted exactly, 1 = no better than 'nothing changes', above 1 = worse
scale.weight_cap: no sense weighs more than this; measured as the largest weight any sense needed in any 100-step window of H84 segments 30-31

scale.pred_err: mean squared distance between the predicted and the actual next vestibular token; 0 = exact, persist_err = the score of predicting no change
scale.improvement_over_persistence: 1 - pred_err / persist_err: 0 = no better than 'nothing changes', 1 = exact, negative = worse
scale.head_tilt_deg: angle of the head from its lying-still-on-the-back orientation, by gravity: 0 = that orientation, 90 = a quarter turn, 180 = upside down
scale.trunk_roll_deg: how far the trunk has rolled from lying on its back, either way: 0 = on the back, 90 = on a side, 180 = face down
scale.trunk_pitch_deg: 0 = trunk horizontal, 90 = head straight up, -90 = head straight down
scale.per_body: the same three per body; trunk_roll_deg there is signed (+ and - are the two sides) and is the direction average over the window
scale.support_trunk: share of outside support carried by the trunk (0-1)
scale.limit_load: share of motor-driven joints within 2.0 degrees of a limit (0-1)
scale.clipped_share: share of real raw values the input bound changed (0 = none). The bound is 4 in each field's own unit: 4 g for the head accelerometer, 4 body weights for support_total, and 4 times the measured 99th percentile for the gyro, neck speeds and the two efforts
scale.lesson_share: the vestibular term's share of the next-moment lesson over the window, at its declared weight (0 = none of the lesson, 1 = all of it; an equal share among five graded senses is 0.2)
scale.input_clipped_share: share of the encoder's centred and scaled inputs that the bound of 4 running spreads changed (0 = none)
scale.input_spread_min: the smallest running spread of any field, in that field's unit, beside the floor it never falls below
scale.input_centre_filled_share: how much of the running mean's 2,000-moment horizon real frames have filled (0 = no real frame yet, 1 = full)
scale.liveness: per hidden layer of the encoder, the share of its units whose input rose above -3 on some moment of the window (0 = a dead layer, 1 = every unit took part)

controllability.gate_why: 32 of the last 32 orders agreed better with what the model expected from the order it sent than with what it would have expected from another body's order (a coin flip gives 16 of 32). The average advantage is 17.9 times its own measurement noise; the gate opens above 3 times and, once open, closes below 1 time. It is open.

scale.persistence_ema: mean squared change of the sense's token between moments; 0 = the token never changes
scale.weight_effective: 1 = as in the plain sum; 2 = the sense counts twice its raw error
scale.share_plain/share_normalized: of every 1.0 of the lesson, the part each sense carries, plain sum vs normalised
scale.ratio: 0 = predicted exactly, 1 = no better than 'nothing changes', above 1 = worse
scale.weight_cap: no sense weighs more than this; measured as the largest weight any sense needed in any 100-step window of H84 segments 30-31

scale.trunk_roll_deg: how far the trunk has rolled from lying on its back, either way: 0 = on the back, 90 = on a side, 180 = face down

scale.per_body: the same three per body; trunk_roll_deg there is signed (+ and - are the two sides) and is the direction average over the window
scale.support_trunk: share of outside support carried by the trunk (0-1)
scale.limit_load: share of motor-driven joints within 2.0 degrees of a limit (0-1)

scale.input_clipped_share: share of the encoder's centred and scaled inputs that the bound of 4 running spreads changed (0 = none)
scale.input_spread_min: the smallest running spread of any field, in that field's unit, beside the floor it never falls below
scale.input_centre_filled_share: how much of the running mean's 2,000-moment horizon real frames have filled (0 = no real frame yet, 1 = full)
scale.liveness: per hidden layer of the encoder, the share of its units whose input rose above -3 on some moment of the window (0 = a dead layer, 1 = every unit took part)

scale.input_centre_filled_share: how much of the running mean's 2,000-moment horizon real frames have filled (0 = no real frame yet, 1 = full)
scale.liveness: per hidden layer of the encoder, the share of its units whose input rose above -3 on some moment of the window (0 = a dead layer, 1 = every unit took part)

controllability.gate_why: 32 of the last 32 orders agreed better with what the model expected from the order it sent than with what it would have expected from another body's order (a coin flip gives 16 of 32). The average advantage is 20.5 times its own measurement noise; the gate opens above 3 times and, once open, closes below 1 time. It is open.

scale.persistence_ema: mean squared change of the sense's token between moments; 0 = the token never changes
scale.weight_effective: 1 = as in the plain sum; 2 = the sense counts twice its raw error
scale.share_plain/share_normalized: of every 1.0 of the lesson, the part each sense carries, plain sum vs normalised
scale.ratio: 0 = predicted exactly, 1 = no better than 'nothing changes', above 1 = worse
scale.weight_cap: no sense weighs more than this; measured as the largest weight any sense needed in any 100-step window of H84 segments 30-31

scale.pred_err: mean squared distance between the predicted and the actual next vestibular token; 0 = exact, persist_err = the score of predicting no change
scale.improvement_over_persistence: 1 - pred_err / persist_err: 0 = no better than 'nothing changes', 1 = exact, negative = worse
scale.head_tilt_deg: angle of the head from its lying-still-on-the-back orientation, by gravity: 0 = that orientation, 90 = a quarter turn, 180 = upside down
scale.trunk_roll_deg: how far the trunk has rolled from lying on its back, either way: 0 = on the back, 90 = on a side, 180 = face down
scale.trunk_pitch_deg: 0 = trunk horizontal, 90 = head straight up, -90 = head straight down
scale.per_body: the same three per body; trunk_roll_deg there is signed (+ and - are the two sides) and is the direction average over the window
scale.support_trunk: share of outside support carried by the trunk (0-1)
scale.limit_load: share of motor-driven joints within 2.0 degrees of a limit (0-1)
scale.clipped_share: share of real raw values the input bound changed (0 = none). The bound is 4 in each field's own unit: 4 g for the head accelerometer, 4 body weights for support_total, and 4 times the measured 99th percentile for the gyro, neck speeds and the two efforts
scale.lesson_share: the vestibular term's share of the next-moment lesson over the window, at its declared weight (0 = none of the lesson, 1 = all of it; an equal share among five graded senses is 0.2)
scale.input_clipped_share: share of the encoder's centred and scaled inputs that the bound of 4 running spreads changed (0 = none)
scale.input_spread_min: the smallest running spread of any field, in that field's unit, beside the floor it never falls below
scale.input_centre_filled_share: how much of the running mean's 2,000-moment horizon real frames have filled (0 = no real frame yet, 1 = full)
scale.liveness: per hidden layer of the encoder, the share of its units whose input rose above -3 on some moment of the window (0 = a dead layer, 1 = every unit took part)

controllability.gate_why: 32 of the last 32 orders agreed better with what the model expected from the order it sent than with what it would have expected from another body's order (a coin flip gives 16 of 32). The average advantage is 18.0 times its own measurement noise; the gate opens above 3 times and, once open, closes below 1 time. It is open.

scale.weight_effective: 1 = as in the plain sum; 2 = the sense counts twice its raw error
scale.share_plain/share_normalized: of every 1.0 of the lesson, the part each sense carries, plain sum vs normalised
scale.ratio: 0 = predicted exactly, 1 = no better than 'nothing changes', above 1 = worse

scale.pred_err: mean squared distance between the predicted and the actual next vestibular token; 0 = exact, persist_err = the score of predicting no change
scale.improvement_over_persistence: 1 - pred_err / persist_err: 0 = no better than 'nothing changes', 1 = exact, negative = worse
scale.head_tilt_deg: angle of the head from its lying-still-on-the-back orientation, by gravity: 0 = that orientation, 90 = a quarter turn, 180 = upside down
scale.trunk_roll_deg: how far the trunk has rolled from lying on its back, either way: 0 = on the back, 90 = on a side, 180 = face down
scale.trunk_pitch_deg: 0 = trunk horizontal, 90 = head straight up, -90 = head straight down
scale.per_body: the same three per body; trunk_roll_deg there is signed (+ and - are the two sides) and is the direction average over the window
scale.support_trunk: share of outside support carried by the trunk (0-1)
scale.limit_load: share of motor-driven joints within 2.0 degrees of a limit (0-1)
scale.clipped_share: share of real raw values the input bound changed (0 = none). The bound is 4 in each field's own unit: 4 g for the head accelerometer, 4 body weights for support_total, and 4 times the measured 99th percentile for the gyro, neck speeds and the two efforts
scale.lesson_share: the vestibular term's share of the next-moment lesson over the window, at its declared weight (0 = none of the lesson, 1 = all of it; an equal share among five graded senses is 0.2)
scale.input_clipped_share: share of the encoder's centred and scaled inputs that the bound of 4 running spreads changed (0 = none)
scale.input_spread_min: the smallest running spread of any field, in that field's unit, beside the floor it never falls below
scale.input_centre_filled_share: how much of the running mean's 2,000-moment horizon real frames have filled (0 = no real frame yet, 1 = full)
scale.liveness: per hidden layer of the encoder, the share of its units whose input rose above -3 on some moment of the window (0 = a dead layer, 1 = every unit took part)

controllability.gate_why: 32 of the last 32 orders agreed better with what the model expected from the order it sent than with what it would have expected from another body's order (a coin flip gives 16 of 32). The average advantage is 16.8 times its own measurement noise; the gate opens above 3 times and, once open, closes below 1 time. It is open.

scale.persistence_ema: mean squared change of the sense's token between moments; 0 = the token never changes
scale.weight_effective: 1 = as in the plain sum; 2 = the sense counts twice its raw error
scale.share_plain/share_normalized: of every 1.0 of the lesson, the part each sense carries, plain sum vs normalised
scale.ratio: 0 = predicted exactly, 1 = no better than 'nothing changes', above 1 = worse
scale.weight_cap: no sense weighs more than this; measured as the largest weight any sense needed in any 100-step window of H84 segments 30-31

scale.pred_err: mean squared distance between the predicted and the actual next vestibular token; 0 = exact, persist_err = the score of predicting no change
scale.improvement_over_persistence: 1 - pred_err / persist_err: 0 = no better than 'nothing changes', 1 = exact, negative = worse
scale.head_tilt_deg: angle of the head from its lying-still-on-the-back orientation, by gravity: 0 = that orientation, 90 = a quarter turn, 180 = upside down
scale.trunk_roll_deg: how far the trunk has rolled from lying on its back, either way: 0 = on the back, 90 = on a side, 180 = face down
scale.trunk_pitch_deg: 0 = trunk horizontal, 90 = head straight up, -90 = head straight down
scale.per_body: the same three per body; trunk_roll_deg there is signed (+ and - are the two sides) and is the direction average over the window
scale.support_trunk: share of outside support carried by the trunk (0-1)
scale.limit_load: share of motor-driven joints within 2.0 degrees of a limit (0-1)
scale.clipped_share: share of real raw values the input bound changed (0 = none). The bound is 4 in each field's own unit: 4 g for the head accelerometer, 4 body weights for support_total, and 4 times the measured 99th percentile for the gyro, neck speeds and the two efforts
scale.lesson_share: the vestibular term's share of the next-moment lesson over the window, at its declared weight (0 = none of the lesson, 1 = all of it; an equal share among five graded senses is 0.2)
scale.input_clipped_share: share of the encoder's centred and scaled inputs that the bound of 4 running spreads changed (0 = none)
scale.input_spread_min: the smallest running spread of any field, in that field's unit, beside the floor it never falls below
scale.input_centre_filled_share: how much of the running mean's 2,000-moment horizon real frames have filled (0 = no real frame yet, 1 = full)
scale.liveness: per hidden layer of the encoder, the share of its units whose input rose above -3 on some moment of the window (0 = a dead layer, 1 = every unit took part)

controllability.gate_why: 32 of the last 32 orders agreed better with what the model expected from the order it sent than with what it would have expected from another body's order (a coin flip gives 16 of 32). The average advantage is 16.7 times its own measurement noise; the gate opens above 3 times and, once open, closes below 1 time. It is open.

scale.persistence_ema: mean squared change of the sense's token between moments; 0 = the token never changes
scale.weight_effective: 1 = as in the plain sum; 2 = the sense counts twice its raw error
scale.share_plain/share_normalized: of every 1.0 of the lesson, the part each sense carries, plain sum vs normalised
scale.ratio: 0 = predicted exactly, 1 = no better than 'nothing changes', above 1 = worse
scale.weight_cap: no sense weighs more than this; measured as the largest weight any sense needed in any 100-step window of H84 segments 30-31

scale.pred_err: mean squared distance between the predicted and the actual next vestibular token; 0 = exact, persist_err = the score of predicting no change
scale.improvement_over_persistence: 1 - pred_err / persist_err: 0 = no better than 'nothing changes', 1 = exact, negative = worse
scale.head_tilt_deg: angle of the head from its lying-still-on-the-back orientation, by gravity: 0 = that orientation, 90 = a quarter turn, 180 = upside down
scale.trunk_roll_deg: how far the trunk has rolled from lying on its back, either way: 0 = on the back, 90 = on a side, 180 = face down
scale.trunk_pitch_deg: 0 = trunk horizontal, 90 = head straight up, -90 = head straight down
scale.per_body: the same three per body; trunk_roll_deg there is signed (+ and - are the two sides) and is the direction average over the window
scale.support_trunk: share of outside support carried by the trunk (0-1)
scale.limit_load: share of motor-driven joints within 2.0 degrees of a limit (0-1)
scale.clipped_share: share of real raw values the input bound changed (0 = none). The bound is 4 in each field's own unit: 4 g for the head accelerometer, 4 body weights for support_total, and 4 times the measured 99th percentile for the gyro, neck speeds and the two efforts
scale.lesson_share: the vestibular term's share of the next-moment lesson over the window, at its declared weight (0 = none of the lesson, 1 = all of it; an equal share among five graded senses is 0.2)
scale.input_clipped_share: share of the encoder's centred and scaled inputs that the bound of 4 running spreads changed (0 = none)
scale.input_spread_min: the smallest running spread of any field, in that field's unit, beside the floor it never falls below
scale.input_centre_filled_share: how much of the running mean's 2,000-moment horizon real frames have filled (0 = no real frame yet, 1 = full)
scale.liveness: per hidden layer of the encoder, the share of its units whose input rose above -3 on some moment of the window (0 = a dead layer, 1 = every unit took part)

controllability.gate_why: 32 of the last 32 orders agreed better with what the model expected from the order it sent than with what it would have expected from another body's order (a coin flip gives 16 of 32). The average advantage is 22.4 times its own measurement noise; the gate opens above 3 times and, once open, closes below 1 time. It is open.

scale.persistence_ema: mean squared change of the sense's token between moments; 0 = the token never changes
scale.weight_effective: 1 = as in the plain sum; 2 = the sense counts twice its raw error
scale.share_plain/share_normalized: of every 1.0 of the lesson, the part each sense carries, plain sum vs normalised
scale.ratio: 0 = predicted exactly, 1 = no better than 'nothing changes', above 1 = worse
scale.weight_cap: no sense weighs more than this; measured as the largest weight any sense needed in any 100-step window of H84 segments 30-31
